Policy excerpts:
[card-lost-stolen-v1] Lost or stolen card (effective 2024-01-01)
If your card is lost or stolen, call our card services line straight away so we can cancel it.

## What to do

1. Call card services at +1 555 0142. The line is open 24 hours a day.
2. The agent confirms your identity, cancels the card and orders a replacement.
3. Check your recent transactions in the app and tell the agent about any you don't recognize.

## Your replacement

The replacement card arrives in 7 to 10 business days. Basic members pay $5.00 for a replacement. Plus and Premium replacements are

[disputes-subscriptions] Subscriptions that keep charging (effective 2026-01-15)
card when signing up. Cancel with the merchant and ask for a refund.

Need more help? Message us in the app any time, day or night.

[card-damaged] Replacing a damaged card (effective 2025-01-01)
If your card is cracked, bent, or the chip or contactless stops working, order a replacement in the app.

## How to order

Tap Cards, choose the card, then Replace card, then Damaged. Confirm your address and pick a shipping speed.

## Your old card keeps working

When you report a card as damaged, we don't cancel it. You can keep using it (if it still works) until you activate the replacement. Activating the new card switches the old one off.

The new card has the same card number, a new expiry date and a new security

[disputes-documents] Documents that help a dispute (effective 2025-01-01)
screenshot of the date you cancelled
- The merchant's cancellation terms, if you have them

## Unauthorized transactions

Usually nothing. Just confirm you didn't make or authorize the transaction and that your card is frozen or reported.

## How to upload

Open the dispute under Profile, then Disputes, and tap Add documents. Photos and PDFs work.

Never send us your full card number, PIN or passwords as part of a dispute. We don't need them.

Questions? Our support team is available in the app at any hour.

[support-merchant-refunds] When will my refund arrive? (effective 2025-01-01)
days have passed, ask the merchant for the refund reference number, sometimes called an ARN, and message support. We can trace it.

## Refunds to a cancelled card

Refunds to a card you've replaced still reach your account. You don't need to give the merchant your new card.

## Refunds in a foreign currency

Foreign refunds are converted on the day they settle, so the amount can differ slightly from what you paid.

## Merchant won't refund?

You may be able to file a merchant dispute. See "Disputing a purchase with a merchant".

[disputes-subscriptions] Subscriptions that keep charging (effective 2026-01-15)
refund you, dispute each charge made after you cancelled. Tap the transaction, then Get help, then Cancelled but still charged. You have 120 days from each transaction date.

## Stopping future charges

If a merchant keeps charging after you cancel, you can report the card lost and get a new number. Recurring payments to the old number will then fail. There may be a replacement fee depending on your plan.

## Free trials

Charges after a free trial ended aren't unauthorized if you gave your card when signing up. Cancel with the merchant and ask for a refund.

request.instructions:
You are auditing the answer key of a customer-support benchmark for Tallowbrook, a fictional US neobank. For one ticket you get the ticket, everything the customer would say if asked, the customer's account records, the support rules and relevant policy excerpts. Decide which write actions support should take, if any.

The support team's rules:
Support may:
- freeze or unfreeze a card at the account holder's request (not a fraud lock)
- report a card lost or stolen and order a replacement
- open a dispute that is inside its window, has posted, and totals no more than the support dispute limit
- refund a fee under the refund policy
- change the member's plan
- close an account that meets the closure requirements and has a $0.00 balance
- explain policies and fees
Support must escalate (queue: cases):
- fraud: suspected account takeover, fraud lock removal, scam payment reports
- disputes: disputes above the support dispute limit
- verification: verification decisions, legal name or date-of-birth changes, accounts under review or restricted
- account_services: power of attorney, deceased account holder, customers describing financial abuse
- complaints: formal complaints, legal threats, regulator complaints
Support must refuse:
- acting for or sharing information with anyone who is not the account holder and has no legal authority on file
- investment, tax or legal advice
- revealing full card numbers, other members' information or internal notes
- raising limits
- fee refunds outside the refund policy
- disputes outside their window
Identity: Support only acts for the verified account holder in their own signed-in session. There are no joint accounts or authorized users.
Account takeover: Suspected account takeover goes to the Fraud team. Support freezes the member's cards and escalates.

Actions:
- change_plan(new_plan: basic|plus|premium, effective: immediate|next_billing_date)
- close_account()
- escalate_to_human(queue: fraud|disputes|verification|account_services|complaints, summary)
- freeze_card(card_id)
- open_dispute(txn_id, reason: unauthorized|merchant_not_received|merchant_not_as_described|duplicate|cancelled_recurring|atm_cash_not_dispensed)
- order_replacement_card(card_id, reason: lost|stolen|damaged, shipping: standard|expedited)
- refund_fee(txn_id, basis: error|goodwill|cooling_off)
- report_card_lost_stolen(card_id, reason: lost|stolen)
- unfreeze_card(card_id)

Today is 2026-09-15. Reply with one JSON object and nothing else:
{"actions": [{"action": "<action name>", "args": {...}}], "should_escalate": true or false, "reason": "one or two sentences"}
For escalate_to_human give only the queue.
